# Pricing

No prices are published, so never quote any amount, rough or exact. Pricing is quote-based.

How pricing works: You pay a one-time setup fee (covering data migration from Excel/Tally, workflow mapping, and staff training) plus a simple subscription based on your product, branches, and user count. No hidden AMC charges and 1-click data export anytime.

Getting a quote: 10-minute scope call to check your branches & staff count — receive a clear written quote on WhatsApp/Email the same day.

## Starter (single branch)
- 1 Branch
- Up to 5 Staff Logins
- 14-Day White-Glove Setup
- 1 branch
- Up to 5 users
- Core business management
- Customer management
- Basic reports
- Basic support
Setup covers: Business profile configuration, Basic GST and business settings, Initial user setup, Branch configuration, Help setting up your first customers and products, Basic data import, Initial system configuration, Product walkthrough, Basic onboarding support.

## Growth (multi-branch)
- Multiple Branches
- Up to 20 Staff Logins
- Role-Based Mobile Access & Approvals
- Multiple branches
- Up to 20 users
- Role-based permissions
- Automated follow-ups
- Advanced reports
- Business configuration
Setup covers: Everything in Starter setup, Multi-branch configuration, Multiple user setup, Role and permission configuration, Help migrating your existing data, Workflow configuration, Admin training, Business-specific onboarding, Advanced configuration support.

## Enterprise (custom scale)
- Unlimited Branches & Users
- Dedicated Cloud Database
- Custom ERP Integrations
- Unlimited branches & staff accounts
- Dedicated cloud database
- Custom module development & API webhooks
- On-site staff & management training
- Priority support — direct founder line, business hours

## Contract and payment
No minimum term or lock-in: cancel any time in writing. Payment is by UPI or bank transfer against our invoice; nothing is charged automatically (no auto-renewal). The monthly price is fixed for the life of the subscription. Refund rules are on /refund.
